prompt: Elena's day is fragmented: deep project work is interrupted by forms, messages and scheduling scattered throughout. Which restructure best protects the deep work?

options.text: Answer every message the instant it arrives, to keep the list clear
Batch the shallow tasks into one or two set windows, leaving longer uninterrupted blocks for the project
Do shallow tasks first all morning, every day, regardless of energy
Abandon the project on days when any admin exists

explanation: Scattered admin repeatedly breaks concentration and each restart costs focus. Batching confines those switches to set windows and preserves long stretches where deep work can actually build.
